name: VCTR AI Token

allocations.name: Founder lock
allocations.destination_wallet: Vesting contract deployed at token launch
allocations.rule_now: Held under the separately published founder-lock rules.

allocations.name: Liquidity
allocations.rule_now: This allocation is held in the liquidity-reserve wallet. Creating or funding a trading pool is optional and separate from token deployment; no pool amount or paired asset is specified or authorized by this allocation alone.

allocations.name: Direct sales
allocations.rule_now: Held in the Seller wallet. Publish the sale terms before selling; do not describe unsold tokens as sold or distributed.

allocations.name: Community and ecosystem
allocations.rule_now: Locked on-chain in a separate immutable timelock. No claim or transfers before 3 fixed 365-day years from token deployment; the named beneficiary can claim the full allocation after the cliff.

allocations.name: Project treasury
allocations.rule_now: Locked on-chain in a separate immutable timelock. No claim or transfers before 3 fixed 365-day years from token deployment; the named beneficiary can claim the full allocation after the cliff. Tokens are not operating cash.

allocations.name: Social causes
allocations.rule_now: Locked on-chain in a separate immutable timelock. No claim or transfers before 3 fixed 365-day years from token deployment; the named beneficiary can claim the full allocation after the cliff. Do not claim a rupee or dollar donation value for these tokens.

founder_lock_rules.custody: All founder tokens are sent to a vesting contract at token launch; the beneficiary wallet receives only released tokens.
founder_lock_rules.start: The token deployment block timestamp, recorded immutably in the vesting contract.
founder_lock_rules.schedule_detail: No release during the first 15 fixed 365-day years. Then continuous linear vesting for 5 fixed 365-day years. At the 20-year point the full 3 billion is vested. The beneficiary claims vested amounts; unclaimed vested tokens may be claimed together.

three_year_allocation_locks.release: After the 3-year cliff, each named beneficiary may claim its full allocation from its separate immutable timelock. No admin or early release exists.

wallet_address_note: The user has confirmed the final deployment wallet inputs. Recheck the exact constructor values immediately before deployment; deployed token allocation destinations cannot be changed.
